reuse.why: The change reuses recurrence conversion, date adjustment, and holiday matching helpers, but the range handler independently implements the daily skipping policy.

duplication.why: The daily weekend-and-holiday exclusion decision is repeated in getNextDate and getDatesInRange rather than shared.

placement.why: Holiday matching and adjustment appropriately live in shared/schedules.ts, but the server range handler also owns scheduling policy that belongs alongside them.

scope.why: All edits directly support the requested scheduling rules, range endpoint, holiday configuration, or associated tests.

maintainability.why: Maintainers must coordinate separate occurrence-processing paths, duplicated daily exclusion decisions, and independently chosen iteration bounds.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/schedules/app.ts:getDatesInRange enumerates and resolves occurrences independently of shared/schedules.ts:getNextDate, reproducing its daily exclusion decision.

disguised_duplication.where: The daily weekend-or-holiday decision appears as an occurrence-advancing loop in getNextDate and as a null-producing map followed by filtering in getDatesInRange.

abstraction_drift.where: getDateWithSkippedWeekend gains a holidays parameter; getNextDate gains a daily-specific branch; getDatesInRange independently reimplements that policy while getUpcomingDates and the budget template retain their separate adjustment paths.
